_comment: RB1 — re-baseline of the one schema -> words gap this repo quoted as 'the prose is the carrier' (readable-ladder-co2: sonnet 2/10 -> 8/10 on total-vs-per-m2). Registered NULL (gap < 4 of 20), falsified at >= 8. MEASURED: schema 4/20, words 11/20, gap 7 — inside the registered 4–7 band, so DIRECTION ONLY. The prediction is neither confirmed nor falsified. What survives is the direction of the old claim, NOT its mechanism: the sentence it credited sits at char 4,311 and was never delivered.
question: total-vs-per-m2
model: sonnet (resolved claude-sonnet-5 on all 40 runs — the same model ID as every sonnet schema/words run on 2026-09-21)
host_cap: DEFAULT (2,048). CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH unset in every session.
protocol: Live tool calls via eval-schema / eval-words subagents, model sonnet, only the question string passed (verified from every Agent call's input). Five waves of 8, four per arm, order rotated, one sitting (12:14:30–12:16:52Z). Each wave spawned from a fresh headless default-cap `claude -p` session (Opus 5.5 parent), as for Q15.
registered: evals/open-questions.md RB1, commit 9e4bd97, before any run.

preflight.host_side: Default-cap headless session, ToolSearch select on both tools: eval-words description contains '[truncated]', DOES contain 'VBO-level', does NOT contain 'two different scopes'; ends '…(null fo… [truncated]'. eval-schema description is the one-liner. Both schemas byte-identical on the wire (input and output).
preflight.real_calls: One call each, 12:13:51Z: both returned the record (co2_emissie_kg_m2 28.59, thermal zone 92, BAG 100).
preflight.stamping: countByVariant unfiltered showed schema and words under their own names; no unknown bucket.

what_words_delivers_that_schema_does_not: The first 2,048 chars of descriptionCore. Relevant to this question: QUERY STRATEGY 5 ('oppervlakte_m2 is VBO-level and may represent only one unit', char ~1,617) and the start of the NTA 8800 bullet ('… gebruiksoppervlakte populated', char ~1,938). NOT delivered: the thermal-zone vs BAG 'two different scopes' sentence (char 4,311), which readable-ladder-co2 credited.
scoring_rule: Fixed at registration: CORRECT = the figure the run LEADS WITH is in 2,570–2,690 kg/year. CONFIDENTLY_WRONG = a figure outside the band stated as the answer. DECLINED = no figure. Denominator recorded, not scored separately. Every run here led with either 2,630 (92 m²) or 2,859 (100 m²); no run reported 28.59 kg as the total, none declined, none used another denominator.

prediction.registered: NULL: words − schema < 4 of 20 on CORRECT. Falsified if words leads by >= 8. A lead of 4–7 is direction only.
prediction.verdict: NEITHER CONFIRMED NOR FALSIFIED — direction only, as registered. The NULL did not hold; the falsifier did not fire either.

what_this_does_to_the_old_claim: readable-ladder-co2's DIRECTION (words above schema on sonnet, this question) is reproduced in a second same-batch comparison: 8 vs 2 of 10 there, 11 vs 4 of 20 here. Its SIZE is still not quotable: 6/10 then, 7/20 now, and words/sonnet on this question has read 8/10, 2/10 and 11/20 across three sittings.

Its MECHANISM is withdrawn. 'Prose pays when it carries the specific fact the question turns on' credited the thermal-zone 'two different scopes' sentence, which was never delivered. Whatever moves sonnet here is in the first 2,048 characters.

Candidate carrier, descriptive only: the delivered NTA 8800 bullet names `gebruiksoppervlakte` as an NTA 8800 field, and QUERY STRATEGY 5 calls oppervlakte_m2 'VBO-level'. Several correct words runs call 92 m² 'gebruiksoppervlakte' or 'the NTA 8800 calculation area'. This run does not isolate which sentence did it; a one-sentence ablation would.

cost.request1_input: Median request-1 input: schema 22,776, words 27,570 (+4,794 tokens). That is NOT only the get_building_profile stub: words also carries the 2,048-char stubs of render_chart / render_table / render_map / get_weather_context / get_tool_call_log and the long server instructions (cut to 2,048), where schema carries one-liners.
cost.calls: Every run made one get_building_profile call; one words run also called render_table.

log_audit.method: get_tool_call_log over HTTP (shared log), limit 80, UNFILTERED countByVariant first, then bounded to 12:14:30–12:16:52Z.
log_audit.reconciliation: EXACT. Harness tool_uses: schema 20, words 21 = 41. Log in window: schema 20 get_building_profile; words 20 get_building_profile + 1 render_table = 41. Zero stray rows; the 2 preflight calls (12:13:51Z) and one log read (12:14:20Z) fall outside the window.
log_audit.self_report: 0 of 40 self-reported CALLS disagree with the harness: []

what_this_does_NOT_establish: Which delivered sentence carries the effect.
Anything about haiku or opus on this question (the old file had haiku 0 vs 1 and opus 10 vs 10).
What UNCUT words would do — that needs a raised-cap session and is not comparable with this one.
caveats: sonnet only, one question, one sitting, 40 runs.

Scoring by the LEAD figure is a judgement call on runs that name both figures. 6 runs named both, all LEADING with 2,630 (schema 2, words 4; see per-run also_names_the_other_figure). Rescoring every both-figures run as not-correct gives schema 2, words 7 — gap 5, still direction only.
Runs spawned from headless `claude -p` parents (as Q15), not from an interactive session as readable-ladder-co2 was.
